message: Don't roll an ad-hoc lead/email filter via inline `python -c`. Use scripts/lead_engine.py with --status / --min-score filters, then loop through outreach_engine.py send. (MISTAKES.md 2026-05-04: Sent to Known-Bad Lead — Notes-Field Filter Gap)

Sending hand-crafted HTML body via raw `send` bypasses the canonical OASIS template path and the geo-rapport feature. Use `send-template` with one of the 3 OASIS template UUIDs. (MISTAKES.md 2026-05-04: Draft Critic vs. OASIS Templates)

DO NOT recreate the cold-outreach Telegram-approval cron. CC opted out 2026-05-16; the script + DB row + callbacks were removed end-to-end. Cold outreach is operator-initiated only via `outreach_engine.py send --lead-id <id>`. Inbound funnel alerts are covered by funnel_fast_poll. See memory/feedback_no_cold_outreach_cron.md + MISTAKES.md 2026-05-16.
